## Pallid Bat (*Antrozous pallidus)*

![](Figures/DOccupancy/fig2_bc_dynamics_ANPA.png)![](Figures/DOccupancy/fig4_regional_dynamics_ANPA.png)

```{r}
#| label: make-interactive-occupancy-maps
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
# top of the make-interactive-occupancy-maps chunk
old_tojson <- options(htmlwidgets.TOJSON_ARGS = NULL)

make_occ_slider_map <- function(sp_code, sp_name,
                                path = "Figures/DOccupancy") {
  
  occ <- read.csv(file.path(path, paste0("site_year_occupancy_", sp_code, ".csv")))
  
  pal_hex <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "OrRd")
  pal_fun <- scales::col_numeric(pal_hex, domain = c(0, 1), na.color = "#bdbdbd")
  
  # map extent from ALL sites so the view doesn't jump between years
  lon_rng <- range(occ$long, na.rm = TRUE) + c(-1, 1)
  lat_rng <- range(occ$lat,  na.rm = TRUE) + c(-0.5, 0.5)
  
  occ_plot <- occ |>
    mutate(
      surveyed   = as.logical(surveyed),
      detected   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(detected)),
      p_occupied = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p_occupied))
    ) |>
    filter(surveyed) |>                                   # only surveyed site-years
    mutate(
      status = ifelse(detected %in% 1, "Detected", "Not detected"),
      symbol = ifelse(status == "Detected", "circle", "triangle-up"),
      fill   = pal_fun(pmin(pmax(p_occupied, 0), 1)),     # colour = P(occupied)
      hover  = paste0(
        "<b>", site, "</b><br>", region,
        "<br>Year: ", year,
        "<br>", status, " (", n_visits, " visits)",
        "<br>P(occupied): ", sprintf("%.2f", p_occupied),
        "<br>\u03c8 expected: ",
        sprintf("%.2f [%.2f\u2013%.2f]", psi_expected, psi_expected_lo95, psi_expected_hi95)
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(year, site)
  
  # point placed off-map, used only to draw legend entries / colourbar
  off_lat <- 0; off_lon <- 0
  
  p <- plot_ly(height = 720) |>
    # animated site layer
    add_trace(
      data = occ_plot, type = "scattergeo", mode = "markers",
      lat = ~lat, lon = ~long, frame = ~year, ids = ~site,
      text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text",
      marker = list(
        symbol = ~symbol, color = ~I(fill), size = 12, opacity = 0.95,
        line = list(color = "#4d4d4d", width = 1)
      ),
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) |>
    # colourbar
    add_trace(
      type = "scattergeo", mode = "markers",
      lat = off_lat, lon = off_lon, hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE,
      marker = list(
        color = 0, cmin = 0, cmax = 1,
        colorscale = list(seq(0, 1, length.out = length(pal_hex)), pal_hex),
        showscale = TRUE,
        colorbar = list(title = list(text = "P(occupied)"), len = 0.45, y = 0.35,
                        tickvals = seq(0, 1, 0.25))
      )
    ) |>
    # shape legend (grey = shape key only; fill colour shows P(occupied))
    add_trace(type = "scattergeo", mode = "markers", lat = off_lat, lon = off_lon,
              name = "Detected", hoverinfo = "skip",
              marker = list(symbol = "circle", size = 11, color = "#bdbdbd",
                            line = list(color = "#4d4d4d", width = 1))) |>
    add_trace(type = "scattergeo", mode = "markers", lat = off_lat, lon = off_lon,
              name = "Not detected", hoverinfo = "skip",
              marker = list(symbol = "triangle-up", size = 11, color = "#bdbdbd",
                            line = list(color = "#4d4d4d", width = 1))) |>
    layout(
      title = list(text = paste0("<b>", sp_code, " \u2014 ", sp_name,
                                 ": probability of occupancy by year</b>"),
                   x = 0.02),
      geo = list(
        scope = "north america", resolution = 50,
        projection = list(type = "mercator"),
        showland = TRUE,  landcolor  = "#f7f7f7",
        showocean = TRUE, oceancolor = "#e8f0f5",
        showlakes = TRUE, lakecolor  = "#e8f0f5",
        showcountries = TRUE, countrycolor = "#9e9e9e",
        showsubunits  = TRUE, subunitcolor = "#c8c8c8",
        lonaxis = list(range = lon_rng),
        lataxis = list(range = lat_rng)
      ),
      legend = list(x = 1.02, y = 0.9)
    ) |>
    animation_opts(frame = 900, transition = 300, redraw = TRUE) |>
    animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: ", font = list(size = 16))) |>
    animation_button(label = "Play")
  
  p
}

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-occ-slider-anpa
#| fig-cap: "Pallid bat (ANPA): probability of occupancy per site by year. Circles = detected; triangles = never detected (colour is model inference)"
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

ANPA <- make_occ_slider_map("ANPA", "Pallid bat")

if (knitr::pandoc_to("html")) {
  ANPA
} else {
  knitr::include_graphics("Figures/DOccupancy/fig7_site_map_by_year_ANPA.png")
}

```

![](Figures/DOccupancy/fig1_covariate_effects_ANPA.png)![](Figures/DOccupancy/fig5_detection_by_year_ANPA.png)
